text:
alex.k: Heads up — new model variant seems to be returning truncated / partial streams on /v1/stream starting ~11:12 UTC. I'm going to push a temporary ingress shunt to route affected traffic to the stable fallback. Need eyeballs + rollback plan.

maria: Which customers are affected? any P0s?

alex.k: A handful of enterprise routes in eu-west-1. No pager yet but telemetry shows 5xx bursts and truncated payloads from worker-variant-03.

sam: Can we match on header to avoid changing all traffic? like header `x-variant=unstable` -> shunt. Quick gateway rule?

alex.k: Plan:
1) Add ingress rule: `match: prefix /v1/stream && header x-variant=unstable` -> route to `fallback-model` pool
2) Attach header override `x-routing-reason=shunt-temp` for observability
3) Set TTL 15m and monitor error % and latency
4) Auto-rollback if errors > 1% for 3m windows or latency regress >200ms

irene: 👍 Add deploy-bot annotation and a console banner. Also add a canary metric/widget to the dashboard for route.v1_stream.{p50,p95,errors}.

ops-bot: @channel Routing rule applied by @alex.k at 1781237890. Rule ID r-9b2cdf. TTL=15m. :white_check_mark:

maria: Who owns the rollback watch? @sam?

sam: I can watch. My rollback trigger script is ready — will run manual revert if we see the thresholds. Auto-rollback enabled as a safety.

alex.k: Rollback command (manual):
```
./gatewayctl rollback --rule r-9b2cdf --reason "auto-rollback" --actor sam
```

irene: Also post a console annotation: `temp-shunt: fallback-model; owner=alex.k; expires=1781238780` so support and CS can see it.

sre-oncall: I'm tailing logs and running a small eval set against fallback-model. Tagging customers most impacted.

ops-bot: Metric alert configured: `route.v1_stream.errors > 1%` for 3m -> notify #incidents and trigger rollback playbook `rb-gateway-shunt`.

maria: Thanks all. Keep this thread updated with any anomalies. :eyes:
